question: Ticket acb4ecd84364 says 'ground loop spawns exactly two listener modules (cairn.devices.cairn.machines.bus pulse and cairn.devices.cairn pulse) on each beat', but outline 5.5.3.4 reads "it launches a script in each device's cairn/devices/<device>/groundloop called pulse.py, each as its own process." (outline states 'it launches a script in each device's cairn/devices/<device>/groundloop called pulse.py, each as its own process'; ticket falsifier requires 'RED if beat spawns anything but the two named modules'; per-device pulse.py and exactly-two listeners are mutually exclusive). Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
answer: The outline stands: it is Akien's translation of the spec and outranks a ticket that disagrees; the gap is the ticket's to close before it builds. The beat launches each device's own groundloop/pulse.py, not two named listeners. CairnComponentOutline.txt: "5.6.4.4 It launches each device's cairn/devices/<device>/groundloop/pulse.py, each as its own process (5.8.3.4)." | "5.8.3.4.1 The ground loop finds one pulse.py per device. pulse.py reads its own device's declared instances (5.7.3.4) and pulses each one, so the ground loop never needs to know instances exist. Pulsing an instance that isn't connected is what starts its shim."
